SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_order_rank = 1 THEN member_id END) AS first_buyer_count
  , SUM(CASE WHEN valid_order_rank = 1 THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_order_rank = 1 THEN order_id END) AS first_order_count
  , COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN valid_order_rank >= 2 THEN order_id END) AS repeat_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_facts" order_facts_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
